scope: Playwright 1.62.1 Chromium library + page projects, including Inspector/codegen. Not Firefox/WebKit, Android, Electron, test-runner, component, installation or language-SDK suites.

cefPin.source: third-party CEF distribution; verified release digest and progressive MP4/MSE H.264+AAC native capture regressions

fixtureChanges: Existing upstream fixture supplies launchEngine browser for CEF; blocks independent browser launch/connect fixtures explicitly. Stock uses real Chromium.
isHeadlessShell reports false for CEF and true for stock headless-shell; tests with product-specific branches may differ.
externalWorkerWatchdog: After an initial >500-second event-loop stall, workers with >200 seconds of sustained CPU activity are externally sampled with GDB and terminated. Watchdog outcomes are explicit, not passes or ordinary test timeouts.
